requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production character asset for OathFront, an original fantasy hero card game with a bold contemporary comic-book art direction inspired by the expressive stylization of Marvel Rivals. Create ONE original character, BRIAR, The Living Bastion. Broad powerful adult female protector, expressive warm determined face, dark brown skin, short sweeping ivory-white hair with one jade braid, heavyweight ivory and jade segmented arcane armor, clearly engineered organic branch structures, glowing small yellow seed core in chest. Massive sculpted living-branch shield on her left arm, compact armored right fist planted forward. Heroic grounded three-quarter stance, strong asymmetrical silhouette, entire body and shield fully visible with generous transparent margins. Clean thick-to-thin ink contours, hard-edged cel-shaded painted forms, graphic shape breakup, stylized angular anatomy, sharp specular facets, warm yellow rim and cool turquoise fill, premium game key-art finish, readable at thumbnail size. Ivory/jade/black palette with controlled yellow highlights. Strong character face and helmet-free identity. No antlers, no cute chibi proportions, no photorealism. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha, isolated full-body character only, no floor, no pedestal, no background, no shadows outside the character, no other figures, no captions, no letters, no logo, no card frame, no watermark. Portrait 2:3 composition, top and bottom body parts not cut off. This must be a newly designed hero, not an existing Marvel character.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production hero art for OathFront, original arcane-fantasy card game. One ORIGINAL character, not an existing Marvel character. Contemporary high-end comic game character art inspired by Marvel Rivals: strong expressive stylized anatomy, graphic hard-edged cel-shaded painted forms, bold clean ink contours, faceted highlights, dramatic yellow rim with cool fill, sharply readable armor and face. Isolated FULL BODY, 3/4 heroic dynamic pose, generous 8 percent empty margins on all sides INCLUDING all weapons and feet. Portrait 2:3. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha. No backdrop, floor, pedestal, ground shadow, captions, text, logo, card frame, watermark or extra characters. No photorealism, no cute/chibi. Character ASTER, The Prism Sentinel: tall athletic adult male guardian with a focused handsome angular face, medium warm skin, swept-back blue-black hair, no helmet, narrow cyan geometric eye markings. Gleaming ivory angular segmented armor with deep navy under-suit and cyan crystal facets, asymmetric short cream cloak. In right hand a long sleek faceted crystal lance, left forearm carries a geometric kite-shaped hard-light shield. Confident upright balanced stance, lance angled diagonally without extending outside frame. Prism geometry and a small yellow oath insignia unify the armor. Distinct slender vertical silhouette, different from a bulky tank. Clear eyes and expression. Full figure and entire lance/shield comfortably inside image.
